text:
matt: Heads up — support reports customers seeing v2 doc shape in console but routed to v1 behavior. Dashboard shows per-variant reads inconsistent. Anyone seen a header-strip or routing quirk recently?

liz: Repro: curl -H 'X-Client-Version: v2' against api.redwood.com -> response body is v1 schema. Header was set by client.

tom: Could be the CDN/edge normalizing headers. We intentionally drop unstable client headers to improve cache hit. That policy changed last month for the v1->v2 rollout.

matt: I pulled a couple of traces, req_id=zz9a: edge got X-Client-Version but internal proxy didn't. Logs: 
```
2024-09-04T08:12:01Z edge req=zz9a headers={X-Client-Version:v2, Authorization:REDACTED} forwarded_to=internal-lb
2024-09-04T08:12:01Z internal-proxy req=zz9a headers={Authorization:REDACTED} routed_to=variant-v1
```
So header is being stripped between services.

nina: That's scary for deprec rollouts. We rely on X-Client-Version for soft routing pins during migration and for metrics. If header gets removed, routing falls back to default which explains the mismatch.

billing-bot: FYI billing pipeline counts tokens by variant tag emitted by runtime (variant=v1/v2) and also by client-reported header in ingestion. We've seen duplication when both systems disagree.

console-product: UX note: console currently shows a single "v2 adoption" chart that mixes client-reported headers and routing-inferred variant. That makes the chart noisy if headers are stripped mid-path. We should split them.

liz: Quick workaround: clients can add both X-Client-Version and X-Redwood-Compat; internal proxies don't touch X-Redwood-* headers. But that's a kludge.

tom: Long term fix: edge allowlist must include the canonical header we use for routing. Suggest canonicalize to `X-Redwood-Client-Version` and update the CDN config to passthrough. Also add a header rewrite to propagate to internal proxy.

matt: I prefer emitting a span tag on ingress like `client.version=v1|v2|unknown` for durable telemetry. That way even if headers are mutated, tracing shows original intent.

nina: Agree. If we add `client.version` to spans at edge and copy to the request span, both console and billing can use that. But we must pick 1 source-of-truth to avoid double-counting.

billing-bot: Action: billing will dedupe by request_id first, then fallback to span.client.version if no runtime variant tag. We'll avoid switching billing behavior until after a short pilot window.

console-product: UX decision: split chart into two series: "client-reported" and "routing-observed" with a small tooltip explaining source-of-truth. We should also add a deprecation banner for v1 that links to migration doc.

liz: Also saw quota alerts: some tenants hit v1 quota while console shows v2 quota usage — cause: both meters recorded the same tokens when header toggled. Example: tenant=beta-corp used 1.2M tokens but billing saw 1.2M under v1 and 1.2M under v2 during the same window.

tom: That's because meters are incremented at two stages: pre-auth (based on client header) and post-route (based on runtime tag). We need a dedupe key at meter ingestion. I propose meter ingestion dedupe on (request_id, tenant).

nina: Dedupe will fix double-counting, but will also hide legitimate retries. We need to only dedupe identical timestamps within the same request flow. Use request_id and event_type to differentiate.

qa-bot: Integration test proposal: simulate header present at edge, strip at internal, ensure trace shows span.client.version=v2 and runtime.variant=v1 and that console shows separate lines. Add test to nightly suite.

matt: Let's agree on concrete steps: 1) CDN/edge allowlist update to passthrough canonical header `X-Redwood-Client-Version` (tom + infra). 2) Emit `span.client_version` on ingress at edge (tom + tracer team). 3) Meter ingestion dedupe by request_id + tenant for 5s window (billing team). 4) Console split chart into client vs routing (console-product). 5) Add integration test and a post-deploy validation runbook (qa + ops).

billing-bot: I'll schedule a billing sandbox run to verify dedupe won't change invoices. ETA: 48h.

console-product: Copy for deprecation banner: "We're sunsetting v1 soon. Differences between client-reported and routing-observed counts may appear during migration; use 'routing-observed' for billing. Follow migration guide: https://redwood.cloud/migrate-v2"

matt: Rollout plan: implement tags and CDN change in staging -> run tests -> two-week canary for 5% tenants -> enable console chart change -> monitor divergence alert.

nina: Small note: ensure the canonical header doesn't conflict with third-party SDKs. We'll communicate in SDK release notes.

tom: I'll open PRs for CDN config + tracer changes. Linking them here when ready.

matt: Thanks. If anyone finds other routes where headers are mutated (k8s ingress, sidecars) please flag. We should be conservative during migration to avoid surprise quota spikes. :eyes:
